- Jeff Lieber selected 118 fathom as new note-taker due to limited minutes on current service, emphasizing the need for effective documentation.
- Financial documents covering the last three years were confirmed sent by Andrew just prior to the meeting, establishing a foundation for discussions.
- Business was founded in 2016 with Jeff starting on Amazon in 2013, revealing a long entrepreneurial journey focused on growth.
- TurnKey operates entirely virtual, with Jeff based in San Diego and a team of 9 US employees plus 10 remote international contractors.
- Trailing 12-month revenue stands at $1.56 million, with an EBITDA of $480,000, demonstrating healthy financial performance.
- Client concentration is high, with the largest client representing 27% of total revenue, signaling the need for diversification.
- Core services include full-service Amazon management, PPC/DSP advertising, and consulting, appealing primarily to brands with $3-30 million in sales.
- The primary merger goal is to attract larger agencies lacking Amazon expertise, aiming for 75-100% equity rollover in the deal.
- Jeff intends to transition to a growth advisor role, stepping back from daily operations while supporting the merger process.
- An anonymous merger listing with NDA protections will be established, highlighting the importance of initial chemistry calls before financial discussions.
